rows.proposalRule: Reuse Package and retain the profile identity, URI, comments, and namespace-prefix facts.
rows.rationale: The official target is suitable, but it does not retain every source fact required by the reverse contract.
testObligations: The generated Package passes the pinned v2 validator.
The reverse mapper restores the Profile rather than an ordinary Package.

rows.officialTarget: Package with URI metadata when present
rows.proposalRule: Reuse Package nesting and URI metadata and retain exact source identity and presence.
rows.rationale: The official rule supplies the semantic target; the manifest supplies reverse-reconstruction details.
testObligations: Nested package paths and URI presence survive the round trip.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse NamespaceImport and retain source-form and target identity.
rows.rationale: Exact href versus local-reference form is part of the preservation contract but not the semantic target.
testObligations: Every imported target resolves offline.
The reverse mapper restores the recorded reference form.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse NamespaceImport for the underlying PackageImport and retain an explicit MetamodelReference discriminator in the preservation manifest.
rows.rationale: The official transformation has no MetamodelReference-specific rule. Its PackageImport rule preserves the import but not the distinction introduced by the applied StandardProfileL2 stereotype.
testObligations: All nine MetamodelReferences reconstruct as MetamodelReferences rather than ordinary PackageImports.
Removing the manifest discriminator causes the round-trip comparison to fail.

rows.proposalRule: Retain each applied Profile and owner in the preservation manifest.
rows.rationale: The official transformation explicitly leaves ProfileApplication unmapped.
testObligations: All eight applications are reconstructed with resolved Profile targets.

rows.proposalRule: Use MetadataDefinition as the primary v2 carrier and retain all source-profile facts needed for reversal.
rows.rationale: The official target is appropriate; source extensions, icons, constraints, and XMI distinctions require preservation data.
testObligations: All 94 MetadataDefinitions validate.
Every Stereotype reconstructs with the same owned bases and generalizations.

rows.officialTarget: Handled in the Stereotype mapping context
rows.proposalRule: Reuse official annotation-target machinery and retain exact base-property, multiplicity, name, and href facts.
rows.rationale: The official mapping represents applicability but not every source representation detail in the round-trip contract.
testObligations: All 84 Extensions and ExtensionEnds reconstruct without inferred names or multiplicities.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse Subclassification and retain source reference form and exact target identity.
rows.rationale: The semantic relationship is direct, but local versus external representation is needed for exact reconstruction.
testObligations: All 219 targets resolve before and after reversal.
Ordered multi-parent examples remain distinguishable.

rows.sourceConstruct: Plain UML Class in a RAAML library without Block or ConstraintBlock applied
rows.proposalRule: Reuse OccurrenceDefinition as the concrete carrier and retain the exact UML Class facts needed for reversal.
rows.rationale: The corpus has 143 UML Classes. Seven select Block_Mapping and 36 select ConstraintBlock_Mapping, leaving 100 plain Classes for Class_Mapping. The proposal's generic Definition carrier is neither the official target nor a validated textual production.
testObligations: All 100 plain library Classes emit validating occurrence definitions.
Class properties, inheritance, connectors, and stereotype applications survive reversal.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Class with SysML v1 Block applied
rows.proposalRule: Reuse PartDefinition and preserve the applied Block identity needed to reconstruct the source Class.
rows.rationale: Seven FTA library Classes have Block applied. A RAAML Stereotype generalizing Block is not itself a source Class with Block applied.
testObligations: All seven Block applications select PartDefinition.
A focused fixture distinguishes stereotype inheritance from Block application.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Class with SysML v1 ConstraintBlock applied
rows.proposalRule: Reuse ConstraintDefinition and preserve the source Class, applied ConstraintBlock identity, parameters, and constraints.
rows.rationale: The corpus contains 36 ConstraintBlocks across the FTA and RBD libraries; the applied stereotype is required for exact reversal.
testObligations: All 36 ConstraintBlocks select ConstraintDefinition.
Constraint parameters and owned constraint expressions reconstruct under the original Class.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML AssociationClass with SysML v1 Block applied
rows.proposalRule: Reuse ConnectionDefinition and preserve both the AssociationClass source kind and applied Block identity.
rows.rationale: STPA RiskRealization is the sole AssociationClass and has Block applied, so it selects AssociationBlock_Mapping rather than Block_Mapping.
testObligations: RiskRealization selects AssociationBlock_Mapping.
Reversal restores AssociationClass, Block application, both parents, and ordered ends.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse the official targets and retain exact literal order and source ownership.
rows.rationale: The native target is suitable, while deterministic reversal requires the frozen source order.
testObligations: All five enumerations and 35 literals reconstruct in source order.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Enumeration with SysML v1 ValueType applied
rows.officialTarget: AttributeDefinition under ValueType_Mapping; EnumerationDefinition under the overlapping Enumeration_Mapping
rows.proposalRule: Use EnumerationDefinition as the primary v2 carrier for these four source Enumerations and retain the ValueType application in the preservation manifest.
rows.rationale: HouseEventProbability, Exposure, Severity, and Controllability are Enumerations with ValueType applied. The official model makes both inherited main mappings applicable but does not state precedence for this overlap. Choosing AttributeDefinition would discard the native enumeration structure for 15 ordered literals, so v0.1 chooses the Enumeration target and records the deviation.
testObligations: All four ValueType Enumerations validate as EnumerationDefinitions.
All 15 literals remain reconstructable in source order.
The reconstructed v1 Enumerations have ValueType applied.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse ConnectionDefinition and retain an AssociationClass discriminator and Class-facet facts.
rows.rationale: The reverse mapper must distinguish the sole AssociationClass from ordinary Associations.
testObligations: RiskRealization reconstructs as AssociationClass with both parents and ordered ends.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse ConnectionDefinition and retain exact association and end facts.
rows.rationale: Ownership, navigability, ordered references, and explicit-value presence are required for reversal.
testObligations: All 40 Associations remain distinct and reconstruct with correct end ownership.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Property named base_* on a Stereotype
rows.officialTarget: Handled by Stereotype metadata and extension mappings
rows.proposalRule: Do not emit a standalone domain property; preserve the exact base Property and Extension facts alongside the MetadataDefinition.
rows.rationale: All 84 base_* Properties are structural parts of UML profile extension semantics and are excluded by the ordinary typed-Property filter.
testObligations: All 84 base Properties remain paired with their Extensions and ExtensionEnds.
Reversal restores exact base names, types, multiplicities, and ownership.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Property owned by an Association
rows.proposalRule: Reuse the owned-end Feature and retain exact Association ownership, member-end order, navigability, and Property facts.
rows.rationale: The official Feature represents the connection end, but source ownership and ordered association membership are required for reversal.
testObligations: All 42 owned ends select OwnedEnd_Mapping.
Owned ends reconstruct under the correct Association in source order.

rows.sourceConstruct: Typed UML Property referenced as a non-owned Association end
rows.proposalRule: Reuse both official views and preserve that the original Property is classifier-owned but referenced by an Association.
rows.rationale: Each of these 41 Properties is both a typed classifier feature and a non-owned association end; collapsing the two roles loses ownership semantics.
testObligations: All 41 Properties produce both required official views.
Reversal does not turn a non-owned end into an Association-owned Property.

rows.sourceConstruct: Typed UML Property owned by a SysML v1 ConstraintBlock
rows.proposalRule: Reuse AttributeUsage and retain the source Property facts and ConstraintBlock ownership.
rows.rationale: The specialized rule takes precedence even when the parameter is typed by a UML Class.
testObligations: All 17 typed constraint parameters select ConstraintParameter_Mapping.
No constraint parameter is misclassified as an OccurrenceUsage.

rows.sourceConstruct: Non-association UML Property typed by a DataType
rows.proposalRule: Reuse AttributeUsage and retain the exact source type reference, aggregation, multiplicity presence, default, modifiers, and subset/redefine relationships.
rows.rationale: The native target is direct, while the source-level distinctions remain necessary for exact reversal.
testObligations: All 45 DataType-typed Properties select Attribute_Mapping.
Absent and explicit values remain distinguishable after reversal.

rows.sourceConstruct: Non-association UML Property typed by a Class or Interface
rows.proposalRule: Reuse OccurrenceUsage and retain the exact source Property facts.
rows.rationale: No Property in this category is typed by a source element with Block applied, so PartProperty_Mapping does not supersede it.
testObligations: All 27 Class-typed Properties select OccurrenceUsage.
No corpus Property in this category selects PartUsage.

rows.sourceConstruct: Untyped UML Property outside a ConstraintBlock
rows.proposalRule: Reuse Feature and preserve that the source type was absent rather than inferred.
rows.rationale: Type absence is a source fact; assigning a convenient v2 type would change the source model.
testObligations: All 11 untyped Properties select PropertyUntyped_Mapping.
Reversal restores an absent type.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Property typed by a Class with SysML v1 Block applied
rows.proposalRule: Use PartUsage only when the source type actually has Block applied.
rows.rationale: No in-scope Property meets this filter; aggregation alone must not select PartUsage.
testObligations: The corpus classifier reports zero PartProperty matches.
A focused fixture proves that Block application, not aggregation alone, selects PartUsage.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse PortUsage and retain original type, multiplicity, and Port identity.
rows.rationale: The corpus contains 51 typed and 14 untyped Ports, both covered by official rules.
testObligations: All typed and untyped Ports validate and reconstruct as Ports rather than Properties.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse ConnectionUsage and preserve ordered role and partWithPort records.
rows.rationale: The official semantic target is usable; exact source-end records are still required for reversal.
testObligations: All 94 connectors retain ordered end role and partWithPort targets.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML Connector with SysML v1 BindingConnector applied
rows.proposalRule: Reuse BindingConnectorAsUsage and preserve the source Connector identity and applied BindingConnector.
rows.rationale: Ninety of the corpus's 94 Connectors select the specialized official binding mapping.
testObligations: Exactly 90 Connectors select BindingConnector_Mapping.
The four ordinary Connectors remain distinguishable from binding Connectors during reversal.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML ConnectorEnd with SysML v1 NestedConnectorEnd propertyPath
rows.proposalRule: Reuse the official feature-chain mapping and preserve the applied NestedConnectorEnd and exact ordered propertyPath.
rows.rationale: The standard requires no separate target for the stereotype, but its propertyPath selects a different ConnectorEnd mapping and is required for reversal.
testObligations: Exactly 125 ConnectorEnds select the feature-chain rule.
Every propertyPath and final role reconstruct in source order.

rows.proposalRule: Reuse Comment and Annotation and retain exact owner, body, and annotated targets.
rows.rationale: Source anchoring and multi-target reconstruction require explicit preservation records.
testObligations: All comment bodies and annotated-element targets compare equal after reversal.

rows.proposalRule: Emit the official ConstraintDefinition and AssertConstraintUsage view, and retain the authoritative source constraint record for reversal.
rows.rationale: The official structural target is useful and reproducible, but it does not prove behavioral equivalence for OCL or JavaScript. Exact source text, owner, constrained elements, comments, and expression metadata therefore remain mandatory preservation facts.
testObligations: All 60 source Constraints retain identity, owner, constrained elements, and source expression.
Every generated native constraint view passes the pinned v2 validator.
No report describes native validation as behavioral equivalence.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML OpaqueExpression used by a Constraint with one language and one body
rows.proposalRule: Emit the official CalculationUsage and TextualRepresentation, and retain the exact source language/body arrays.
rows.rationale: These 59 expressions each have exactly one language and one body, matching the official get(0) rules. The corpus contains 33 OCL2.0 and 26 JavaScript expressions; preservation still retains exact text and source ordering.
testObligations: Language/body order and exact text survive reversal.
All 33 OCL bodies continue to parse and resolve source names.

rows.sourceConstruct: UML OpaqueExpression used by a Constraint with a body but no language
rows.officialTarget: CalculationUsage; the official TextualRepresentation language rule evaluates invalid
rows.proposalRule: Do not invent a language for FMEALib RPNCalculation; retain its exact unlabeled body in the preservation manifest and report that no faithful native textual representation was emitted.
rows.rationale: OpaqueExpressionSpecification_Mapping requires language.get(0), which is invalid when the language collection is empty. Guessing a language would add a source fact that RAAML 1.1 does not contain.
testObligations: The unlabeled RPN=SEV*DET*OCC body reconstructs without an added language.
The report identifies the omitted native textual representation explicitly.

rows.proposalRule: Preserve format, location, encoding, and content without inventing native v2 icon semantics.
rows.rationale: The official transformation states that Image mapping is not specified.
testObligations: All 22 image records compare exactly after reversal.

rows.officialTarget: Arbitrary-stereotype handling uses implementation-specific applied-stereotype discovery
rows.proposalRule: Retain every application target and tagged value in the preservation manifest; a v2 MetadataUsage may be emitted as an additional navigable view.
rows.rationale: The official StereotypeOccurenceUsage rules take a Stereotype definition as their source, not an individual application instance, and do not bind the resulting usage to the applied element or map its tagged values. Applied-stereotype and tag-value discovery are explicitly implementation-specific helpers.
testObligations: Every application target and tagged value reconstructs exactly.
Removing or changing any application record causes the fact comparison to fail.
Any emitted MetadataUsage is reported as a supplemental view rather than an official application mapping.

rows.proposalRule: Preserve the prefix as artifact metadata without assigning native v2 semantics.
rows.rationale: The prefix is a source/interchange fact rather than a UML or SysML semantic element.
testObligations: The Core profile RAAMLC prefix reconstructs exactly.
